name: Argentina
description: A federal presidential republic and the second-largest country in South America. Defined by its immigrant heritage, complex federal structure, and oscillation between developmentalist and neoliberal economic models.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: From Viceroyalty to Confederation and Peronist era transitions, 1816 to present.

works.title: Institutional Map
works.description: Province and autonomous city distribution across the federal structure.

works.title: Inter-Agency Graph
works.description: Federal-provincial fiscal relations and co-participation dynamics.

name: Brazil
description: Brazil is a federal presidential republic in South America and the largest country in both area and population in the region. It possesses a diversified economy spanning agriculture, mining, manufacturing, and services, and plays a central geopolitical and ecological role due to the Amazon rainforest and its membership in major multilateral groupings.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal visualization of Brazil’s public, private, and civil actors from independence to the present, highlighting structural transformations in the state, industrial sector, and financial system.

works.title: Product Space Mapping
works.description: Network representation of Brazil’s export structure and industrial diversification patterns, with emphasis on commodities, agribusiness, energy, and advanced manufacturing.

works.title: Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of federal units, metropolitan regions, and economic corridors, including Amazonian, coastal, and southern industrial zones.

name: China
description: China is Party-State polity in East Asia and the world's most populous major state. Governed by a single-party system under the Chinese Communist Party, it has transformed over the past four decades from a largely agrarian economy into a global industrial and technological power. China plays a central role in global manufacturing, trade, infrastructure development, and emerging technologies.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of China’s actor space from imperial dynasties and bureaucratic elites to revolutionary transformation under the Chinese Communist Party, followed by reform-era technocratic governance and contemporary state-capitalist institutional structures.

works.title: Industrial and Technology Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of China’s manufacturing clusters, state-owned enterprises, private technology firms, export logistics networks, and global infrastructure initiatives such as the Belt and Road.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of China's provinces, major metropolitan clusters, industrial corridors, port systems, and internal economic zones.

name: Dominican Republic
description: The Dominican Republic is a sovereign presidential republic on the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean, sharing its territory with Haiti. Historically shaped by sugarcane, mining, and tourism, it has evolved into a dynamic economy with strong remittance inflows, diversified services and industrial sectors, and growing investments in renewable energy and infrastructure.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of the Dominican Republic’s actor space from colonial-era plantation elites and early independence movements to Trujillo dictatorship, democratic transitions, and contemporary institutional consolidation.

works.title: Agro-Export and Energy Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of sugar, cacao, coffee, and free-trade zone exports, alongside renewable energy infrastructure and integration into Caribbean and global trade flows.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of provinces, agricultural zones, urban concentration, port infrastructure, and tourism hubs.

name: England
description: England is a constituent country of the United Kingdom located in Western Europe. It was the core territorial and institutional base of the early modern English state and later the British Empire. England played a central role in the Industrial Revolution, the development of parliamentary governance, common law traditions, and the formation of modern financial and industrial capitalism.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal analysis of England’s evolving actor space from medieval monarchy and landed aristocracy to industrial capitalists, financial institutions, parliamentary structures, and modern regulatory bodies.

works.title: Industrial Transformation Dynamics
works.description: Structured timeline of England’s transition from agrarian economy to industrial capitalism, including textile mechanization, coal-energy systems, rail infrastructure, and urbanization.

works.title: Financial and Commercial Network Structure
works.description: Network representation of merchant banks, trading companies, insurance markets, and global commercial linkages centered in London.

name: Hong Kong
description: Hong Kong is a Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China, located on the southern coast of China. It has a highly developed, service-oriented economy, historically rooted in trade, finance, and logistics. Hong Kong is a major global financial center and port, with strong legal and regulatory institutions inherited from its colonial history under the United Kingdom. In recent years, there has been a push to develop technology and innovation sectors alongside traditional finance and professional services.

specific.nativeName: 香港特別行政區 (Heung Kong Dak Bit Hang Jing Keui) / Hong Kong SAR

statistics.value: Special Administrative Region (Under ‘One Country, Two Systems’)
statistics.label: System of Government

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Hong Kong’s actor space from colonial administration and trade networks to financial institutions, multinational corporates, and contemporary regulatory authorities.

works.title: Industrial and Trade Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of Hong Kong’s financial, logistics, and emerging technology sectors, including integration into regional and global production and trade networks.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of Hong Kong’s administrative districts, urban centers, ports, technology parks, and transport infrastructure.

name: India
description: India is a sovereign federal parliamentary republic in South Asia and the world’s most populous country. It combines a long civilizational history with modern constitutional governance established in 1950. India has a structurally diversified economy spanning agriculture, manufacturing, and a globally competitive services and technology sector, and plays an increasingly central role in Indo-Pacific geopolitics and multilateral institutions.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of India’s actor space from colonial administration and nationalist movements to post-independence state-building, economic liberalization (post-1991), and contemporary public-private institutional configurations.

works.title: Federal Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of states and union territories, demographic density gradients, industrial corridors, and regional development asymmetries.

works.title: Technology and Services Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of India’s IT services, pharmaceutical production, startup ecosystems, and integration into global value chains.

name: Indonesia
description: Indonesia is a sovereign archipelagic republic in Southeast Asia composed of more than 17,000 islands. It is the world’s largest Muslim-majority country and one of the most populous nations globally. Indonesia has a diversified economy based on natural resources, manufacturing, and services, and plays a central geopolitical role within ASEAN and the broader Indo-Pacific region.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Indonesia’s actor space from colonial administration and independence-era leadership to the New Order regime, post-1998 reforms, decentralization, and contemporary political-economic coalitions.

works.title: Archipelagic Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of Indonesia’s provinces, maritime corridors, resource basins, and inter-island economic integration patterns.

works.title: Commodity and Industrial Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of Indonesia’s commodity exports (coal, palm oil, nickel), downstream industrialization strategies, and integration into global value chains.

name: Ireland
description: Ireland is a sovereign parliamentary republic in Western Europe occupying most of the island of Ireland. Since the late 20th century, it has transformed into a high-income, small open economy characterized by strong foreign direct investment inflows, a competitive corporate tax regime, and specialization in pharmaceuticals, information technology, and financial services within the European Union framework.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Ireland’s actor space from colonial administration and independence to state-led development, EU integration, and FDI-driven multinational clustering.

works.title: Economic Transformation Dynamics
works.description: Structured timeline of Ireland’s shift from agrarian economy to export-oriented, knowledge-intensive sectors during the Celtic Tiger period and beyond.

works.title: Multinational Corporate Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of multinational enterprises operating in Ireland, sectoral concentration patterns, and integration into EU and global value chains.

name: Malaysia
description: Malaysia is a federal constitutional monarchy in Southeast Asia composed of Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysian states on the island of Borneo. Since independence, it has transitioned from a commodity-based economy to an export-oriented manufacturing and services hub, with strong specialization in electronics, palm oil, and petroleum, supported by industrial policy and integration into regional and global value chains.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Malaysia’s actor space from colonial administration and resource extraction to post-independence federal consolidation, New Economic Policy reforms, and export-oriented industrialization.

works.title: Industrial and Trade Network Structure
works.description: Network representation of Malaysia’s electronics clusters, palm oil value chains, energy sector, and integration into ASEAN and global production networks.

works.title: Federal Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial analysis of Peninsular and East Malaysian states, economic corridors, port infrastructure, and regional development differentials.

name: Netherlands
description: The Netherlands is a constitutional monarchy in Western Europe known for its advanced, trade-oriented economy and long-standing maritime and commercial tradition. Historically central to early modern global trade and finance, it remains a major logistics and distribution hub within Europe, with strong sectors in agriculture, chemicals, high-tech manufacturing, and financial services.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of the Netherlands’ actor space from merchant republic institutions and chartered trading companies to modern parliamentary governance, multinational corporations, and EU-integrated regulatory bodies.

works.title: Trade and Logistics Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of ports, shipping routes, distribution centers, and integration into European and global value chains.

works.title: Spatial and Water Management Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of provinces, delta works, reclaimed land (polders), and infrastructure systems supporting flood control and urban-economic concentration.

name: New Zealand
description: New Zealand is a sovereign island nation in Oceania composed primarily of the North and South Islands. It operates as a parliamentary democracy and constitutional monarchy. Historically shaped by Māori settlement and later British colonization, New Zealand developed a high-income, export-oriented economy centered on agriculture, agri-technology, tourism, and services, with strong institutional quality and regulatory transparency.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of New Zealand’s actor space from Māori polities and colonial administration to welfare-state expansion, economic liberalization (post-1984 reforms), and contemporary regulatory institutions.

works.title: Product Space Evolution
works.description: Network analysis of dairy, meat, forestry, and agri-technology sectors, including export linkages to Asia-Pacific markets.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of regions, major urban centers, infrastructure networks, and environmental management systems.

name: Portugal
description: Portugal is a unitary semi-presidential republic on the Iberian Peninsula's Atlantic edge and one of Europe's oldest nation-states. Pioneer of the Age of Discovery with a deep seafaring and mercantile tradition, it moved from dictatorship to democracy with the 1974 Carnation Revolution and joined the European Communities in 1986. Its open economy leans on services, tourism, cork, wine and olive oil, with fast-growing technology and renewable-energy sectors.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Portugal's actor space from Age of Discovery maritime institutions and colonial trading networks through the Estado Novo corporatist state to democratic governance, EU-integrated regulatory bodies, and contemporary firms and public institutions.

works.title: Lusophone Economic Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of trade, investment, migration and energy ties binding Portugal to Brazil, Angola, Mozambique and the wider Community of Portuguese Language Countries, alongside integration into EU value chains.

works.title: Coastal and Energy Transition Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of coastal demographic concentration, Atlantic ports and fisheries, and the build-out of wind, solar and hydro capacity supporting decarbonization and territorial cohesion.

name: South Korea
description: South Korea is a sovereign presidential republic in East Asia located on the southern portion of the Korean Peninsula. Following the Korean War, it transitioned from a low-income agrarian economy to a high-income, export-oriented industrial and technological power. Its development model combined state-led industrial policy, chaebol-centered conglomerate growth, human capital accumulation, and deep integration into global value chains.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of South Korea’s actor space from post-war military governance and state-led industrialization to democratization, chaebol consolidation, and contemporary regulatory and innovation ecosystems.

works.title: Industrial Policy and Structural Transformation
works.description: Structured timeline of heavy and chemical industry drives, export promotion strategies, technology upgrading, and transition toward advanced manufacturing and digital sectors.

works.title: Chaebol and Innovation Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of major conglomerates, supplier ecosystems, research institutions, and integration into global semiconductor, automotive, and electronics value chains.

name: Sweden
description: Sweden is a constitutional monarchy in Northern Europe characterized by a high-income, export-oriented economy and a comprehensive welfare state. Historically transitioning from agrarian society to industrial power in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, Sweden developed globally competitive firms in engineering, automotive, telecommunications, and life sciences, supported by strong institutions, human capital formation, and social partnership models.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Sweden’s actor space from agrarian estates and monarchy to industrial conglomerates, labor unions, welfare-state institutions, and innovation-driven enterprises.

works.title: Industrial and Innovation Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of Sweden’s engineering firms, automotive and telecom sectors, research institutions, and integration into European and global value chains.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of counties, metropolitan regions, transport infrastructure, and spatial concentration of industrial and knowledge clusters.

name: Thailand
description: Thailand is a constitutional monarchy in Southeast Asia with a diversified, export-oriented economy. Historically the Kingdom of Siam, it avoided formal colonization and underwent gradual modernization in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Since the late 20th century, Thailand has developed strong manufacturing sectors—particularly automotive and electronics—alongside tourism and agro-industrial exports, integrated into regional and global value chains.

specific.nativeName: ราชอาณาจักรไทย (Ratcha-anachak Thai) / Kingdom of Thailand

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Thailand’s actor space from monarchical-administrative structures and military influence to export-oriented industrialization, business conglomerates, and contemporary regulatory institutions.

works.title: Industrial and Trade Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of Thailand’s automotive clusters, electronics manufacturing, agro-industrial exports, and integration into ASEAN and global production networks.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of provinces, economic corridors (including the Eastern Economic Corridor), infrastructure systems, and regional development patterns.

name: Uruguay
description: Uruguay is a sovereign presidential republic in South America located between Brazil and Argentina along the Atlantic coast. Historically shaped by livestock-based exports and early welfare-state development, it has evolved into a relatively stable democracy with strong institutions, diversified agricultural exports, growing services sectors, and a high share of renewable energy generation in its electricity matrix.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Uruguay’s actor space from 19th-century state formation and livestock oligarchies to welfare-state consolidation, military rule, democratic restoration, and contemporary regulatory institutions.

works.title: Agro-Export and Energy Network Structure
works.description: Network analysis of beef, soy, forestry, and cellulose exports, alongside renewable energy infrastructure and integration into Mercosur trade flows.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of departments, agricultural zones, port infrastructure, and population concentration patterns.

name: Vietnam
description: Vietnam is a One-Party State polity located in Southeast Asia, bordered by China, Laos, and Cambodia, with an extensive coastline along the South China Sea. It operates under a one-party system led by the Communist Party of Vietnam. Historically shaped by Chinese rule, French colonization, and the Vietnam War, the country has transitioned into a rapidly growing emerging economy with key sectors including agriculture, manufacturing, electronics, and services. Institutional development and regulatory frameworks remain evolving, with strong state involvement in strategic economic sectors.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Vietnam’s political and economic actors, from traditional dynasties and colonial administration to socialist state structures, Doi Moi reforms, and contemporary governance institutions.

works.title: Product Space Evolution
works.description: Network analysis of rice, coffee, electronics, and manufacturing sectors, including trade linkages within ASEAN and global markets.

works.title: Regional Spatial-Administrative Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of provinces, major urban centers, transport infrastructure, and economic zones.
